items.label: High Quality Material
items.value: High-quality PU leather fabric and exquisite stitching for a comfortable feel. 2 magnetic buckle locks and smooth metal zipper provide easy access to your items and keep them secure, durable gold hardware adds to the eye-catching appeal of this shoulder bag

items.label: Removable Strap
items.value: This clutch purse measures 9.84*2.56*6.3 inches and comes with 1 detachable handle strap and 1 complimentary detachable long gold metal chain that provides versatility, allowing you to wear it as a crossbody or shoulder bag

items.label: Spacious Space
items.value: This shoulder bag for women has a main pocket, a inner zipper pocket and 3 inner slots pocket. The spacious space can accommodate wallets, credit cards, drivers license, sunglasses, skin care products, cosmetics, keys, and mobile phones, etc

items.label: Trendy Design
items.value: The trendy Irregular flap design looks more lovely and leads the fashion trend, and whether you're running errands or attending a party, this cute purse will effortlessly complement your look with its chic design, It makes you more visible in the crowd

items.label: Perfect Gift for Ladies
items.value: This trendy purse is a chic and versatile accessory. It is the perfect gift choice for ladies on birthdays, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Christmas, Graduations and any day worth celebrating

items.label: Included Components
items.value: Detachable Handle Strap, Detachable Gold Metal Chain

items.label: Pocket Description
items.value: Patch Pocket, Slip Pocket, Slit Pocket
